description: This Science Data Bank release catalogues 762 landslides and unstable slopes in a 10-kilometre buffer on both sides of the China–Pakistan Karakoram Highway. Lanzhou University and partner researchers used radar deformation monitoring, optical imagery, terrain and geological layers, then checked and corrected locations in the field. The package describes a road-corridor boundary, landslide vector locations and attribute documents. Fields include type, area, coordinates, slope, lithology, rainfall, vegetation and distance to the highway. The repository page is public under CC BY 4.0. The inventory can be used for road hazard-exposure simulations and resilience planning. It helps define exposed links or compare hazard-screening methods in the corridor. The authors report that 78.7 percent of remotely identified deformation slopes were verified accurately; that does not establish an event probability for every mapped feature. The related Gilgit-Baltistan inventory and susceptibility deposit already drafted in G4 covers a different route and producer team. File geometry, dates of individual landslides and attribute completeness were not checked by download.
name: A dataset of catalog and characteristics of landslides along China-Pakistan Karakoram Highway
